transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get started on reviewing the implementation plan for our Civics Now digital curriculum pilot. Before I can sign off on this, I need to walk through the plan with our instructional coach and librarian as part of the formal implementation review process. Could we go over the key details together?

transcript.text: Dr. Ellis, before we go further, I need to share an important finding from my survey of the participating teachers.
